verdict.rationale: The only verifiable identity is the intermediary's. Calls to the merchant-hosted cart API carry PayPal-issued JWTs that the merchant must check against PayPal's public keys, so PayPal-brokered agent traffic can be told apart from unauthenticated callers. But PayPal's Shopping Cart service, not the AI agent itself, calls the merchant, and delegated payment tokens are bound to the merchant ID rather than to an agent identity. Missing for 10: per-agent registered profiles, agent-level signatures or verifiable agent identity, trust tiers, merchant-facing tooling to see which agent originated traffic, and independent corroboration.
